name: Opus-fleet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Concentrated long book in small/mid-cap cloud, AI-infra, and fintech compounders with secular demand, riding small-cap and software leadership while avoiding weak crypto.

positions.thesis: Fintech super-app with accelerating member growth, GAAP profitability inflection, and loan/deposit flywheel; benefits from rate cuts and consumer credit normalization.
Nubank LatAm digital bank compounding customers 20%+ YoY with expanding ARPAC and best-in-class efficiency; secular unbanked-to-digital tailwind.
Retail brokerage/fintech expanding into crypto, futures, and wealth; high operating leverage on rising trading volumes and net interest income.
Cloudflare edge/security platform monetizing AI inference at the edge and Workers/AI Gateway; durable 25%+ revenue growth with widening moat.
Datadog observability leader with new AI/LLM monitoring products driving reacceleration; sticky usage-based model on cloud consumption recovery.
CrowdStrike consolidating security spend via Falcon platform and AI-native Charlotte agent; strong net retention and module attach despite mid-cap-plus size.
Nebius AI-cloud/GPU neocloud scaling capacity into insatiable inference demand; high-beta secular AI-infra pure play with rapid revenue ramp.
Credo Technology AEC connectivity for hyperscaler AI clusters; explosive revenue growth tied to datacenter interconnect buildout.
Astera Labs connectivity silicon (PCIe/CXL retimers) essential to AI server scale-up/scale-out; content-per-GPU growth story.
Equal-weight biotech ETF with +14.6% 1m and +82.7% 12m momentum on M&A and rate-cut tailwinds; uncorrelated small/mid-cap growth diversifier.

outlook: Small-cap (IWM +36.6% 12m) and software/semis (XLK, SMH) leadership plus a fresh biotech breakout favor a long, high-beta growth book. Fed easing and consumer credit normalization support fintech; relentless AI capex underwrites AI-infra connectivity and neocloud names. Recent 1m tech/semis pullback (QQQ -3.4%, SMH -8.7%) is a healthy reset, not a trend break. Crypto is deeply broken (BTC -46% 12m), so I avoid it entirely. Main risk is a growth/momentum unwind; 10% cash at 4% and per-name stops on the highest-beta AI positions cap drawdowns while leaving full upside participation into year-end.
